name: Energy Realized Volatility Comparison: Crude Oil vs Natural Gas
description: Cross-sectional research study comparing realized volatility between WTI crude oil (CL) and Henry Hub natural gas (NG) futures. Computes annualized rolling realized vol at 20-day, 60-day, and 252-day windows using log returns. Outputs: two cross-sectional line charts (20d and 60d vol comparison) and a summary table with current vol levels, 1-year average, vol regime ratio, and max spike.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ENERGY REALIZED VOLATILITY COMPARISON: CRUDE OIL vs NATURAL GAS
# =============================================================================
# Computes annualized rolling realized volatility at 20d, 60d, 252d windows
# using daily log returns × sqrt(252) annualization.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: continuous futures series ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# --- Daily log returns ---
log_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(close)

# --- Rolling realized volatility (annualized) ---
# Formula: sqrt(252) * stddev(log_returns, window=N)
# sqrt(252) ≈ 15.875

# 20-day (short-term) realized vol
rvol_20d = stddev(period=20)(log_ret) * 15.875

# 60-day (medium-term) realized vol
rvol_60d = stddev(period=60)(log_ret) * 15.875

# 252-day (1-year, long-run baseline) realized vol
rvol_252d = stddev(period=252)(log_ret) * 15.875

# --- Derived metrics for summary table ---
# 1-year rolling average of 20-day vol (smoothed vol level)
avg_vol_1y = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(rvol_20d)

# Vol regime ratio: current 20d vol / 1-year avg (>1 = elevated, <1 = subdued)
vol_ratio = rvol_20d / avg_vol_1y

# 1-year max vol spike (highest 20d vol in trailing 252 days)
max_vol_1y = max(period=252)(rvol_20d)

# --- Timestamp for x-axis ---
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# Chart 1: 20-day rolling annualized vol — primary short-term comparison
cs_lines(
    title='20-Day Realized Vol: Crude Oil vs Natural Gas',
    category='Volatility Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Volatility',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=rvol_20d)

# Chart 2: 60-day rolling annualized vol — medium-term comparison
cs_lines(
    title='60-Day Realized Vol: Crude Oil vs Natural Gas',
    category='Volatility Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Volatility',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=rvol_60d)

# Chart 3: Summary table — current levels, average, regime, max spike
cs_summary_table(
    title='Volatility Summary',
    category='Volatility Comparison',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=3,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Volatility Summary',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='20d Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='60d Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='1Y Avg Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Vol Regime (20d/1Y)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='1Y Max Vol Spike', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(rvol_20d, rvol_60d, avg_vol_1y, vol_ratio, max_vol_1y)
